title: Provide option to save all klipper history to a file
line: The clipboard applet's menu has a new "Export History…" action that saves the whole text history to a file.
explanation: There was no way to get the clipboard history out of Plasma as a whole: the old workaround of copying history2.lst stopped working when the history moved to an SQLite database, and the only other way was a D-Bus script. The change adds an "Export History…" action (shown when the history isn't empty) to the clipboard applet's context menu; it opens a save dialog and writes every text and URL entry, newest first, one after another on new lines, keeping multi-line entries intact and skipping images.

commits.message:
applets/clipboard: add an action to export the history to a text file

Since the history moved to an SQLite database there was no easy way to
get all of it out at once. Add an "Export History…" action to the menu
of the applet that saves every text and URL entry to a chosen file.

BUG: 307792

media.caption: Right-clicking the clipboard icon: only Clear History and Configure
The same menu now has Export History…
Export History… opens a save dialog for a .txt file
The saved file: every text entry of the history, multi-line entries intact
